name: com.carterchen247.alarmscheduler.service.RescheduleAlarmService
description: When requested after a reboot or exact-alarm permission change, CarterChen247 Alarm Scheduler reloads and reschedules saved alarms. It restores the app's pending reminders and scheduled tasks.
disableEffect: Pending app alarms may not be restored after reboot or after exact-alarm access changes.
